## Summary

- [ ] Linked issue (or `N/A`)
- [ ] Summary of changes
- [ ] Contract change type: `additive` / `semantic change` / `breaking` / `N/A`

## Type of Change

- [ ] Token addition (additive)
- [ ] Token semantic change
- [ ] Breaking contract change
- [ ] Documentation / config only
- [ ] Refactor (no contract change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (13-gate validation)
- [ ] Token sources changed in `tokens/` only (not in `dist/` or
      `src/generated/`)
- [ ] Generated outputs regenerated via `npm run build`
- [ ] Locked color families unchanged (or explicit approval from Bradley Potts
      noted)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]` updated with `Contract change type:` line
- [ ] `README.md` and `TOKEN_CONTRACT.md` updated if public contract surface
      changed
- [ ] `contract.manifest.json` updated if public namespaces or required
      outputs changed
